name: Stat Tile
description: A framework-free Web Component for the headline numbers on an admin dashboard: a value, what it changed by, an optional sparkline, and an optional meter against a limit. The direction is read from the number and the judgement from the author, so a rise in costs is not green.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A value, its change, and a sparkline drawn from readings that stay in the page.

variants.name: Row
variants.description: Four tiles whose labels, values and changes line up, and the filter row that belongs above them.

variants.name: Delta
variants.description: Same arrow, opposite news, and a change that is never carried by colour alone.

variants.name: Meter
variants.description: A value against a ceiling, with the track in the fill's own hue and the state in words.

variants.name: Hero
variants.description: The one number a view leads with, and why there is exactly one of it.

variants.name: States
variants.description: Refetching, a failure, the trend taken off, and a number nobody has yet.
